O-step weights encode compression rate per tick
Layers emerge from coarse O-value binning
Phase boundaries mark transitions between compression regimes
Stable subgraphs form uniform compression plateaus
Multi-scale hierarchy from coarse-graining small-dO edges
Cumulative O is a conserved current: sum(dO) = O(T-1)
